context: Evaluates correct use of the procedural start/stop profiling API in spprof. Focuses on whether the candidate correctly calls start() with the right interval, retrieves the Profile from stop(), and accesses profile properties.

checklist.name: start() called correctly
checklist.description: spprof.start() is called with interval_ms=5 before the workload runs

checklist.name: stop() returns Profile
checklist.description: spprof.stop() is called after the workload and its return value (Profile object) is stored in a variable

checklist.name: sample_count accessed
checklist.description: The profile's sample_count property is accessed and printed

checklist.name: total_duration_ms accessed
checklist.description: The profile's total_duration_ms property is accessed and printed (rounded to 2 decimal places)

checklist.name: RuntimeError on double-start
checklist.description: Calling start() while profiling is already active raises RuntimeError (either tested or handled appropriately)
